regimeSub: SPX retraces 0.8% as Warsh hiking cycle bites while 10Y holds 4.96% with oil sticky near $97.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% + 'more tightening ahead' rhetoric keeps 2Y at 4.71% → real rate +100bps vs 3.7% Aug CPI while Q2 GDP at 1.5% confirms growth rolling over under restrictive policy
Retail sales beat at +1.2% MoM per Census Sept 16 release → consumer resilience complicates Fed pivot calculus, core PCE sticky at 3.3% keeps Warsh hawkish bias intact through year-end

Brent cools to $97.30 from $98.81 as Saudi output disruptions from Iran-Hormuz clashes ease per WSJ → still elevated enough to maintain CPI pass-through risk, gold down to $4327 from $4372 on modest de-hedging
BOK 1%pt rate gap vs Fed post-Sept hike pressures won → USDKRW widens to 1371 from 1351 despite SK HBM boom; KOSPI holds 7080 on SK Hynix AI chip demand but FX headwinds building

headline: Warsh's hawkish Sept 16 hike cycle grinds on with 3.7% CPI still double target, 10Y yields stabilize at 4.96% as SPX gives back 0.8% and oil eases to $97 from Hormuz stress highs.
